records.jp: 日菜子。あれから調子はどう？
records.en_original: How've you been doing since we last talked, Hinako?
records.en_auxiliary: How've you been since we last talked, Hinako?
records.en: How've you been doing since we last talked, Hinako?

records.jp: うん。地道に頑張ってるよ
records.en_original: Pretty good. I've been working hard.
records.en_auxiliary: Pretty good. I've been working hard.
records.en: Yeah. I've been working at it steadily.

records.jp: と言っても、みんながいる時じゃないと意味が無いから、<CR>学校以外じゃ関係ないんだけどね
records.en_original: Well, during school hours, at least. I can't do much without having everybody around.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, during school hours, at least. I can't do much without having everybody around.
records.en: Though it only really matters when everyone is around,<CR>so it doesn't affect what I do outside school.

records.jp: そういえばそうね。<CR>じゃあ、夜とか休みの日はどうしてるの？
records.en_original: That's true. So what do you do at night, or on days off?
records.en_auxiliary: I suppose that's true. So what do you do at night or on days off?
records.en: Oh, right.<CR>Then what do you do at night or on days off?

records.jp: そうだね、色々だけど――
records.en_original: Well, all kinds of things...
records.en_auxiliary: Well, different sorts of things.
records.en: Well, all kinds of things...

records.jp: 勉強をしてることが多いかな
records.en_original: Mostly studying, I'd say.
records.en_auxiliary: Lately, I'd say I've mostly been studying.
records.en: Mostly studying, I'd say.

records.jp: そっか。最初の２か月とはいえ、だいぶ進んでるものね
records.en_original: That checks out. You've only been here for two months, but you've already made a lot of progress.
records.en_auxiliary: That checks out. You've only been here for two months, but you've already made a lot of progress.
records.en: I see. We're only two months in, but you've already covered quite a lot.

records.jp: うん。特にこっちは普通科だから、<CR>そっちのクラスより座学が多いしね
records.en_original: It helps that I'm in general education, so I get more lectures than your class does.
records.en_auxiliary: It helps that I'm in regular classes, so I have more lectures than your class does.
records.en: Yeah. Especially since I'm in the Regular Class,<CR>I have more classroom subjects than your class does.

records.jp: 英語とかは大丈夫だけど、暗記科目は大変だよ
records.en_original: I'm fine at things like English, but classes involving memorization are hard.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm fine at things like English, but classes involving memorization are hard.
records.en: I'm fine at things like English, but classes involving memorization are hard.

records.jp: そっか……。バレエのことは何かしてないの……？
records.en_original: Interesting... So you aren't doing anything related to ballet...?
records.en_auxiliary: Interesting. So you aren't doing anything related to ballet?
records.en: Interesting... So you aren't doing anything related to ballet...?

records.jp: うん……。ちょっと前までは見るのも辛かったからね……。<CR>だけど、今は海外の公演とかの動画は見てるよ
records.en_original: Kind of... It was painful just to watch until a while ago, but now I watch videos of foreign performances and stuff.
records.en_auxiliary: Kind of... It was painful for me to watch until recently, but now I watch videos of foreign performances and stuff.
records.en: Yeah... Until recently, even watching was painful.<CR>But now I watch videos of performances overseas.

records.jp: そっか……
records.en_original: I see...
records.en_auxiliary: I see...
records.en: I see...

records.jp: バレエの動画を見てることが多いかな。<CR>海外のとか、参考になるのもそうだけど、見てて楽しめるし
records.en_original: I watch a lot of ballet videos. Foreign videos make for good reference, and they're a lot of fun to watch.
records.en_auxiliary: I watch a lot of ballet videos. Stuff from other countries makes for good reference, and they're a lot of fun to watch.
records.en: I mostly watch ballet videos.<CR>Performances from overseas are useful as reference, but they're fun to watch too.

records.jp: そう……。バレエにはもう触れてないのかと思ったわ……
records.en_original: I see... I thought you were avoiding ballet.
records.en_auxiliary: I see... I thought you were avoiding ballet.
records.en: I see... I thought you were avoiding ballet.

records.jp: ちょっと前まではそうだったよ
records.en_original: I was, until a little while ago.
records.en_auxiliary: I was until a little while ago.
records.en: I was, until a little while ago.

records.jp: 諦めきれずにリハビリしてたけど、<CR>他の人がやってる姿は見れなかった……
records.en_original: I didn't want to give up, and I was doing rehab, but I couldn't take watching the others...
records.en_auxiliary: I didn't want to give up, and I was doing rehab, but I couldn't take watching the others.
records.en: I was doing rehab because I couldn't give up,<CR>but I couldn't bear to watch other people dance...

records.jp: 日菜子……
records.en_original: I'm sorry...
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako...
records.en: Hinako...

records.jp: でもね、今はもう大丈夫。原種を倒して、<CR>私はもう一度バレエを踊る
records.en_original: But I'm fine now. I'll defeat the Sephirot and go back to dancing ballet.
records.en_auxiliary: But I'm fine now. I'll defeat the Sephira and go back to dancing ballet.
records.en: But I'm okay now. I'll defeat the Sephira,<CR>and I'll dance ballet again.

records.jp: だから、そのための準備はしなきゃ
records.en_original: I've got to be ready for that.
records.en_auxiliary: I've got to be ready when that time comes.
records.en: So I need to prepare for that.

records.jp: そっか……
records.en_original: You're right.
records.en_auxiliary: I see...
records.en: I see...

records.jp: あのさ、日菜子。<CR>ちょっと話があるのだけど、時間とれないかしら？
records.en_original: Um, Hinako? There's something I wanted to ask, do you have some time?
records.en_auxiliary: Um, Hinako? There's something I wanted to ask you. Got a moment?
records.en: Hey, Hinako.<CR>There's something I want to talk about. Can you spare some time?

records.jp: うん、大丈夫だけど
records.en_original: Sure.
records.en_auxiliary: Sure.
records.en: Sure.

records.jp: じゃあ、屋上まで付いてきて
records.en_original: Then let's go to the rooftop.
records.en_auxiliary: Then, let's go to the roof.
records.en: Then come with me to the rooftop.

records.jp: あれ、ヒナちゃんと更紗ちゃん？
records.en_original: Huh? Hina and Sarasa?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Hina and Sarasa?
records.en: Huh? Hina-chan and Sarasa-chan?

records.jp: どうしたの、二人そろって
records.en_original: What brings you here?
records.en_auxiliary: What brings you here?
records.en: What are you two doing here together?

records.jp: うん、ちょっとね……
records.en_original: Oh, nothing much...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, nothing much.
records.en: Oh, nothing much...

records.jp: 更紗どうする？　別の場所に変える？
records.en_original: What do you want to do, Sarasa? Should we go somewhere else?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you want to do, Sarasa? Should we go somewhere else?
records.en: What do you want to do, Sarasa? Should we go somewhere else?

records.jp: いいわ。人目につかなくて広い場所に来たかっただけだから
records.en_original: It's fine. I just wanted to go somewhere spacious, but also kind of private.
records.en_auxiliary: It's fine. I just wanted to go somewhere spacious, but also kind of private.
records.en: It's fine. I just wanted to go somewhere spacious, but also kind of private.

records.jp: 何々？　もしかして相談事？
records.en_original: What's up? Is there something you wanna talk about?
records.en_auxiliary: What's up? Is there something you wanna talk about?
records.en: What's up? Is there something you wanna talk about?

records.jp: ええ……実は、今度あるコンクールでやる予定の演技を<CR>見てもらいたくって……
records.en_original: Yeah... To tell the truth, I wanted you to watch a performance I'd planned for the upcoming competition...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... To tell the truth, I wanted you to watch a performance I'd planned for the upcoming competition.
records.en: Yes... Actually, I wanted you to watch the performance<CR>I'm planning for an upcoming competition...

records.jp: コンクールって……ああ、もうそんな時期なんだね……
records.en_original: Competition...? I guess it is that time of year already...
records.en_auxiliary: A competition? I guess it is that time of year already.
records.en: Competition...? I guess it is that time of year already...

records.jp: ええ。大きなものだし納得のいくものにしたいと思っているわ。<CR>細田先生にも問題ないと言われたわ
records.en_original: Yup. It's a big event, so I want to go all out. Hosoda-sensei said there's no problem with that.
records.en_auxiliary: Yup. It's a big event, so I want to go all out. Ms. Hosoda said there's no problem with that.
records.en: Yes. It's a major competition, and I want to give a performance I'm happy with.<CR>Hosoda-sensei also said there weren't any problems with it.

records.jp: ……そっか
records.en_original: ...I see.
records.en_auxiliary: That's interesting to know.
records.en: ...I see.

records.jp: 細田先生……って、さらちんのバレエの先生？
records.en_original: Hosoda-sensei... Wait, is that your ballet teacher, Sara?
records.en_auxiliary: Ms. Hosoda? Wait, is that your ballet instructor, Sara?
records.en: Hosoda-sensei... Wait, is that your ballet teacher, Sara-chin?

records.jp: ええ。あと、日菜子のバレエの先生にもあたるわ
records.en_original: Yeah. Hinako's as well.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. Hinako's as well.
records.en: Yeah. Hinako's as well.

records.jp: 高校進学のタイミングで、同じバレエスクールに通うことにしたの。<CR>身近で学べることもあると思って
records.en_original: We decided to go to the same ballet school, when we were both accepted at Hoshinomiya. It's pretty close by.
records.en_auxiliary: We decided to go to the same ballet school when we were both accepted at Hoshinomiya. It's pretty close by.
records.en: When I started high school, I decided to attend the same ballet school.<CR>I thought there would be things I could learn from her up close.

records.jp: そうだったんだ
records.en_original: Good idea.
records.en_auxiliary: Good idea.
records.en: I see.

records.jp: でも、その先生にお墨付きをもらっても、納得ができてないの？
records.en_original: But even though your teacher gave you the go-ahead, you're still not sure about your performance?
records.en_auxiliary: But even though your teacher gave you the go-ahead, you're still not sure about your performance?
records.en: But even though your teacher gave you the go-ahead, you're still not sure about your performance?

records.jp: ええ……漠然とだけど、ね……。<CR>だから、日菜子にも意見をもらいたくて……
records.en_original: Yeah... It might sound kind of odd, but... I wanted to hear Hinako's opinion, too...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. It might sound kind of odd, but... I wanted to hear Hinako's opinion, too.
records.en: Yes... It's only a vague feeling, but...<CR>That's why I wanted your opinion too, Hinako...

records.jp: 更紗……
records.en_original: Sarasa...
records.en_auxiliary: Sarasa...
records.en: Sarasa...

records.jp: （たぶん、私に聞くのはプライドが許さないはずなのに、<CR>それを我慢してでも聞くなんて……）
records.en_original: (I'm sure she had to swallow her pride to ask me like this...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I'm sure it was hard to swallow her pride to ask me what I thought.)
records.en: (I'm sure her pride normally wouldn't let her ask me,<CR>but she swallowed it and asked anyway...)

records.jp: （更紗もやっぱり、バレエが一番なんだね。<CR>なら、それに応えないと）
records.en_original: (Ballet's the most important thing to Sarasa, too. It's the least I can do watch her perform.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Like me, ballet's the most important thing to Sarasa. The least I can do is watch her perform.)
records.en: (Ballet really is the most important thing to Sarasa too.<CR>Then I have to live up to that.)

records.jp: ……いいよ。じゃあ踊ってみて
records.en_original: Sure. Show me what you've got.
records.en_auxiliary: Okay. Show me what you've got.
records.en: Okay. Then go ahead and dance.

records.jp: ……ありがとう
records.en_original: ...Thank you.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you.
records.en: ...Thank you.

records.jp: ……なるほどね
records.en_original: ...Interesting.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, that's something.
records.en: ...I see.

records.jp: 何かわかったの！？
records.en_original: Did you notice something!?
records.en_auxiliary: What did you notice?!
records.en: Did you notice something!?

records.jp: うん。更紗、終わる直前のステップ部分だけ、<CR>柔らかさが足りない
records.en_original: I did. Sarasa, the steps right before the end lacked grace.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, the steps right before the end weren't as graceful as the rest.
records.en: Yeah. Sarasa, only the steps right before the end<CR>aren't fluid enough.

records.jp: 前半部分はまだ体力が残ってるから大丈夫なんだろうけど、<CR>途中から気合で乗り切ろうとしてる印象だったよ
records.en_original: Your first half was fine, since you had plenty of stamina, but partway through, it felt like you lost your spirit.
records.en_auxiliary: Your started off strong, but partway through, it felt like you started to struggle. Your spirit didn't come through.
records.en: The first half is fine because you still have stamina,<CR>but from midway through, it felt like you were trying to power through on sheer will.

records.jp: ！？　……確かに、そうかもしれない
records.en_original: !? ...You might be right.
records.en_auxiliary: ...You might be right.
records.en: !? ...You might be right.

records.jp: 今フリスペのチャットで練習メニューを送るから<CR>ちょっと待っててね
records.en_original: I'll send you a practice course through FreeSpace chat, wait just a second.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll send you a practice course through FreeSpace chat. Wait just a second.
records.en: I'll send you a training routine through FreeSpace chat now,<CR>so wait a moment.

records.jp: こんなところかな？
records.en_original: That should do it.
records.en_auxiliary: There. Can you see it?
records.en: Something like this?

records.jp: すごく細かい部分まで指定が入ってるわね。<CR>でもこんな量でいいの？
records.en_original: It has a lot of really detailed instructions. Are you sure about this?
records.en_auxiliary: It has a lot of really detailed instructions. Are you sure about this?
records.en: You've specified even the tiniest details.<CR>But is this amount really enough?

records.jp: 効率を重視してるからね。<CR>更紗も忙しいだろうし、短い時間で終わる方がいいでしょ？
records.en_original: It stresses efficiency. I'm sure you're busy, don't you want to get it done as quickly as possible?
records.en_auxiliary: This is the most efficient way. Don't you want to overcome this as quickly as possible?
records.en: It's designed for efficiency.<CR>You're busy too, Sarasa, so it'd be better if it didn't take long, right?

records.jp: それはそうだけど……
records.en_original: That's true, but...
records.en_auxiliary: I suppose, but...
records.en: That's true, but...

records.jp: じゃあ、試しにちょっとやってみようか。<CR>そうすればわかると思うから
records.en_original: Alright then, give it a try. I'm sure it'll all make sense once you do it.
records.en_auxiliary: All right then, give it a try. I'm sure it'll all make sense once you start moving your feet.
records.en: Then let's try a little of it.<CR>I think you'll understand once you do.

records.jp: 面白そう！　ユズたちもやってみようよ
records.en_original: It sounds fun! We should join in, too.
records.en_auxiliary: It sounds fun! We should join in, too.
records.en: That sounds fun! We should try it too.

records.jp: ええー……
records.en_original: Sure.
records.en_auxiliary: Sure.
records.en: Ehh...

records.jp: よーし。じゃあみんなでやってみようか。<CR>じゃあまずは――
records.en_original: Okay, let's all try it then. First you...
records.en_auxiliary: Okay, let's all try it then. First you...
records.en: All right. Then let's all give it a try.<CR>First—

records.jp: はぁ……はぁ……
records.en_original: *huff*... *puff*...
records.en_auxiliary: *Huff* *Puff*
records.en: *huff*... *puff*...

records.jp: きついー！　もう動けないよー
records.en_original: I'm dead! I can't move another step...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm dead! I can barely lift my legs.
records.en: This is brutal! I can't move anymore!

records.jp: あんなに簡単な動作なのに……
records.en_original: It's such a simple movement, but...
records.en_auxiliary: The movements seem so simple, and yet...
records.en: It's such a simple movement, but...

records.jp: 効率を重視してるからね。<CR>このやり方だとすごく鍛えられるでしょ？
records.en_original: I did say it stresses efficiency! This gives you a really good workout, doesn't it?
records.en_auxiliary: I did say the focus is on efficiency! This gives you a really good workout, doesn't it?
records.en: It prioritizes efficiency.<CR>You can see how effective this method is, right?

records.jp: ええ……すごいわ……。<CR>日菜子は……いつもこんなメニューをこなしてたの？
records.en_original: Yeah... It's amazing... Hinako... Were you always doing courses like this?
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, it's amazing. Hinako... Were you always training like this?
records.en: Yes... Amazing...<CR>Hinako... Did you always do routines like this?

records.jp: やっても週に１回だよ。やり過ぎると負担が大きいからね
records.en_original: Only once a week, at most. Any more than that stresses the body too much.
records.en_auxiliary: Only once a week at most. Any more than that and you risk getting injured.
records.en: Only once a week, at most. Any more than that stresses the body too much.

records.jp: わかったわ。<CR>ひとまずこのメニューをこなしてみる
records.en_original: Thanks for letting me know. I'll try to master it, then.
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks for letting me know. I'll try to master it.
records.en: Got it.<CR>I'll try following this routine for now.

records.jp: うん。また何かあったら言ってね
records.en_original: Great. Let me know if you need anything else.
records.en_auxiliary: Great. Let me know if you need anything else.
records.en: Great. Let me know if you need anything else.

records.jp: ありがとう
records.en_original: Wil do.
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks.
records.en: Thank you.

records.jp: （休みの日にしていることは？）
records.en_original: (What do I do on days off?)
records.en_auxiliary: (What do I do on days off?)
records.en: (What do I do on days off?)
